The resulting framework provides a rigorous, quantifiable foundation for mitigating lower extremity injuries in professional football.

The laboratory testing poster serves as a communication protocol, aligning these incentives by providing an objective, quantifiable metric. Players, acting as the ultimate users, rely on this synthesized intelligence to make informed choices, trusting that the 'Top-Performing Group' designation balances their competitive needs with physiological preservation.
